title: Dawn-Chorus Activity Peak
dataSources: BirdNET detections (`birdnet:detection`), trail-cam detections (`trailcam:detection`), moth-trap captures (`mothtrap:capture`), bat-detector passes (`batdetector:pass`), pollinator counts (`pollinator:count`), wildlife-cam visits (`wildlifecam:visit`).
app: Backyard wildlife monitoring — BirdNET acoustic bird ID, trail cameras with object detection, camera moth traps, ultrasonic bat detectors, and pollinator counts — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=birdnet:detection
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats count as calls by hour
| sort hour
description: Maps bird-call activity by hour to reveal the dawn chorus peak and the quieter middle of the day.
value: The dawn chorus is a delight; charting call activity by hour shows exactly when your garden is most alive with birdsong.
implementation: Ingest BirdNET detections; review call counts by hour of day.
visualization: Column chart of bird-call activity by hour of day.
grandmaExplanation: It shows what time of day the birds sing most, capturing the lovely dawn chorus in your garden.
